caption: Did you know your brain has a 'stress boss'? 🧠💡 Corticotropin-releasing hormone (CRH) is the hormone that initiates your body's stress response. 🚨 Here are 5 key facts: CRH is released by the hypothalamus, 🌟 it stimulates the pituitary gland to release ACTH, 🌈 which then triggers the adrenal glands to produce cortisol. 🌱 Chronic stress can lead to CRH imbalance, affecting your mood, energy, and overall health. 🤕 Save this so you don't lose it.
